name: Iveren Ann Lyam
bio:
Iveren Ann Lyam is a distinguished lawyer and the founder of The Relevant Woman, a vibrant community of resilient young women, inspired by greatness, shaping and influencing culture  across various spheres of society. Driven by her passion for community development, Iveren is deeply committed to leadership, personal growth, and mental health, serving as a mentor and coach to others. Her dedication to leadership skills and mental well-being has led her to be certified on multiple courses with the Maxwell Certified team and the Immerse Coaching Company.

Iveren has successfully organized a series of impactful projects and programs that have greatly benefited young people in her community. Among her many accomplishments, Iveren is notable for being:The first female presidential candidate for the National Law Students Association of NigeriaThe first contestant from Bingham University in the National Students AssociationThe first female director of the North Central Students' Rights Directorate (LAWSAN)The first female international director in the Directorate of Students' Rights for the Federation of African Law Students

Iveren has received recognition for her exceptional contributions through various awards, including being named one of the 20 Exceptional & Outstanding Law Students by Lawverse Magazine in 2022.

Her core values—Faith, Love, Excellence, commitment, Resilience, kindness,  and Balance—are the driving forces behind her productivity and success

name: Iwuese Tessy Ekanem
bio:
Iwuese T. Ekanem is a seasoned energy professional with over eight years of experience spanning stakeholder engagement, strategic business development, leadership and project management. 

She holds a bachelors  degree in Petroleum Chemistry from Nigerian Turkish Nile University, now known as Nile University of Nigeria, and a masters degree in International Oil and Gas Management from the prestigious University of Dundee in Scotland, United Kingdom. 

Iwuese has also completed executive certifications in Global Energy and  Environmental Politics from Harvard University, Strategy Execution from Harvard Business School Online, and Leading 21st Century Teams from Lagos Business School.

name: Nguavese Jennifer Tokula
bio:
Nguavese J. Tokula is the Chief Executive Officer of Wellspring Educational Foundation, a Certified Management Consultant, and a Fellow of the Institute of Management Consultants (IMC-Nigeria). 

With a dynamic career spanning several years, she has worked with diverse organizations, specializing in the creation and optimization of systems that drive growth, impact, influence, and income.

A visionary and passionate educator, Nguavese developed a transformative curriculum and operational framework for vibrant children’s ministries across multiple centers of a leading ministry in Nigeria. She also founded and successfully led an international nursery and primary school in Gboko, located in North Central Nigeria. What began with just her son has now grown into a thriving institution with over 140 students and more than 20 dedicated staff members.

Drawing from her strong background in technology and education, Nguavese is committed to raising fearless, godly leaders who are driven by love for their communities and equipped to make lasting impact. As a Maxwell Leadership Coach and Trainer and a TEDx speaker, she is frequently sought after to train educators and marketplace professionals in transformational leadership and peak performance.

Her academic background includes a B.Sc. in Computer Science, along with professional certifications in Human Resource Management, Project Management, and Contemporary Global Challenges in Educational Leadership and Policy. She holds a Master’s degree in Educational Administration and Planning, is a Microsoft Certified Educator, and a registered member of the Teachers’ Registration Council of Nigeria. In addition, as a Certified Administrator of the Accelerated Christian Education (ACE) Curriculum, she has successfully homeschooled two of her children over the past four years.

Nguavese is passionate about transformational leadership, continuous personal development, and being a blessing to her generation. She is happily married to her beloved husband of 17 years, and together they are raising three wonderful children in Abuja, Nigeria.

name: Oladimeji Ayoyemi
bio:
Ayoyemi Oladimeji is a systems engineer, artificial intelligence researcher, and technology entrepreneur with experience spanning enterprise systems, data analytics, and applied machine learning. He is currently a Ph.D. candidate in Systems Engineering at Johns Hopkins University, where his research focuses on developing AI-driven, systems-based decision-making tools to address complex public health and critical healthcare challenges. 

Mr. Oladimeji holds a Master’s degree from the University of Leeds and an additional Master’s degree from Johns Hopkins University, providing him with a strong interdisciplinary foundation in engineering, analytics, and systems modeling. He earned his Bachelor’s degree from Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST). In addition to his academic training, he has founded and led multiple technology ventures in the United States and Africa, building platforms that support digital services, scalable communication, and economic participation. 

As a board member, Mr. Oladimeji brings systems-level strategic thinking, technical expertise, and entrepreneurial leadership, supporting the organization’s mission with a focus on governance, long-term impact, and operational excellence.

name: Blessing Ingyape
bio:
Blessing Ingyape is an internationally certified dyslexia coach and special needs educator with over 14 years of experience building impact in a field that was once poorly understood and deeply stereotyped. Through resilience, strategic thinking, and purpose-led leadership, she pioneered practical dyslexia support by working directly with children, training teachers, and equipping parents, while building sustainable structures for long-term impact.

She is the founder of Dyslexia Help Africa, Forgex Academy, and Dyslexia Project Africa, initiatives that have expanded from local interventions to international training platforms. Blessing's journey of building, scaling, and sustaining mission-driven organisations positions her to mentor young women in business strategy, performance, leadership, and purpose, helping them pursue meaningful impact without fear.

name: Esty Eche
bio:
Esty Eche works at the intersection of people, systems, and growth. She supports individuals and organizations through people operations, human resource administration, and product management, bringing clarity to vision, structure to process, and excellence to execution.

She is known for intentionally curated events, thoughtful systems, strong team cultures, and experiences rooted in values, not just good intentions. Esty loves to train, speak, and communicate, whether facilitating learning sessions, delivering impactful talks, or lending her voice as a voiceover artist.

As the founder of Ignite With Esty, a people-centered service brand, her mission is to ignite lives and organizations to reflect excellence, clarity, and lasting impact. She believes influence is built through consistency, intentional leadership, and space that give room for people to become their best selves.

name: Gift Adashikem Odey
bio:
Odey Gift Adashikem serves as the Human Resources and Administration Lead at The Relevant Woman Organization, where she oversees people operations, organizational coordination, and administrative systems that support the organization's mission and growth.

She holds a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree and has successfully completed the Nigerian Law School. Her legal training equips her with a strong foundation in employment relations, compliance, policy development, and structured decision-making—skills she applies thoughtfully within her HR and administrative role.

Beyond her legal and HR expertise, she is an entrepreneur and creative professional, with active skills spanning branding, content development, project coordination, and strategic execution. This blend of structure and creativity allows her to contribute not only to internal operations but also to the organization's outward expression and engagement.

She is passionate about building efficient systems, nurturing people, and supporting purpose-driven initiatives that empower others to grow, lead, and thrive.

name: Victoria Wilson
bio:
Wilson Victoria Phin is the Project Manager of The Relevant Woman, She leads The Relevant Woman team, coordinates projects, and ensures seamless execution with a hands-on approach. She prioritizes efficiency, quality, and measurable results, turning ideas into well-structured, high-impact initiatives.

She is also an LLB candidate with a focus on Corporate Law and Governance, certified in DLA Piper's M&A Simulations. She is keenly focused on entertainment/media and certified in Intellectual Property Law. Her expertise combines legal knowledge with strategic project management to deliver organized and scalable outcomes.

Outside of her professional and academic pursuits, Victoria is passionate about children's development and empowerment. She is also experienced in planning, organization, and speaker curation; skills honed through leadership roles in school and community projects.

name: Treasure Babalola
bio:
Babalola Treasure is a communications, brand, and campaign manager for The Relevant Woman, and a creative ideator with over three years of experience in building, positioning, and scaling brands. His work spans corporate, personal, and private brands, where he develops digital solutions that drive sustainability and long-term growth.

As an ideator, he has contributed significantly to brand strategy, messaging, and architecture, with professional experience across sectors including agriculture and energy. He has also successfully pioneered and managed initiatives from their maiden editions, notably African Writers Connect 1.0 and 2.0 and Beyond the Easel 1.0, demonstrating a strong ability to translate ideas into structured, impactful programs.

Treasure is an alumnus of Nasarawa State University and an active member of the Creative Writers Association (Keffi Chapter) and African Writers Connect. A prolific poet, he has written over 100 poems and is widely recognized for his critical engagement with literature across genres.

He is equally the Executive Director of AESYRS Foundation, contributing to youth empowerment initiatives across Nigeria. As an Editorial Manager, he has edited and proofread over a hundred legal and non-legal articles, reflecting strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.

Babalola Treasure works at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and literature, positioning him as a versatile professional in communications, branding, and the creative arts.

name: Solomon O. Olagoroye
bio:
Solomon O. Olagoroye works at the intersection of technology, media, and brand growth. He leads IT, Media & Marketing at The Relevant Woman, where he builds digital systems that support storytelling, audience growth, and measurable results. 

Alongside this, he works with Omaplex Law Firm in the Communications Department as Head of Technology and Operations, partnering with the PR, branding, and marketing teams to ensure the technology and operations behind public communications are solid, efficient, and dependable.Solomon combines software engineering with media and brand strategy, helping organisations turn vision into practical execution.

 His work includes websites, internal tools, and digital platforms built for everyday use, many of which are available on his GitHub at github.com/femiwebdev.He is curious about how technology shapes people, businesses, and opportunities, especially within Africa's growing digital landscape. He believes relevance is not accidental; it is built through clarity, consistency, and work that delivers real value.

name: Mercy D. Shamaki
bio:
Mercy D. Shamaki is the Event and Operations Manager of The Relevant Woman. In this role, she ensures that the team work efficiently and effectively for the success of every event through value communication, building awareness and publicity, partnerships and brand perception.

With expertise in Moderating panel discussions and event hosting for Design Consulting Agencies and Space related initiatives, Mercy brings on board over three years of experience in shaping conversations for the benefit of the rising generation, especially women. She values every opportunity to improve, execute and learn from experts who serve as leverage.

Mercy's passion for personal leadership has led her to engage in volunteering projects with communities and organisations like GOTNI Leadership Centre, Speakers' Cafe, Beyond The Classroom, Space Generation Advisory Council and many more.

In December 2024, she was was awarded the Spotlight Volunteer by GOTNI Leadership Centre, as the first to receive such commendation and setting the example for others to follow. In December 2025, she came up as part of the top ten students at I-Train Africa in the Workplace Fundamental Skills program. This gave her access to exclusive opportunities. 
She also shares ideas through her social platforms to continue impactful conversations.

name: Cynthia Kyala Christopher
bio:
Cynthia Kyala Christopher is the Social Media Manager of The Relevant Woman, where she drives digital visibility, content strategy, and audience engagement with a structured and results-focused approach. Naturally curious and open-minded, she continuously learns, experiments with innovative ideas, and adapts quickly to strengthen creative performance and brand consistency.

Beyond The Relevant Woman, she is a Mass Communication & Media Studies enthusiast with a focus on Public Relations. She also offers personal assistance to high-profile individuals. 

She is also Freelance Talent Manager for a modeling group, and the CEO of Kay's Empire, a beauty brand specializing in professional makeup artistry, hairstyling, and creative gift packaging. She is also a Graphics Designer, bringing strong visual precision into every project.

name: Nguter Esther Terlumun
bio:
Nguter Esther Terlumun serves as the Publicity Personnel at The Relevant Woman, where she crafts compelling narratives and drives digital engagement. 

With a passion for connecting brands with audiences through impactful communication, Esther plays a vital role in enhancing the organization's outreach.

In addition to her professional pursuits, she is a Doctor of Pharmacy student and the founder of "SHE is Royalty." As a social media enthusiast, content creator, and advocate for natural hair, Esther embraces her identity as a Christ-follower. 

She is dedicated to continuous learning and is always exploring innovative ways to connect people with purpose.

name: Gift Omeghie Ilogho
bio:
Ilogho Omeghie Gift is a purpose-driven content creator at The Relevant Woman, where she crafts compelling, values-centered email content that connects, inspires, and empowers women. 

She studies law with a strong foundation in advocacy and service, and has served as an SDGs Ambassador, reflecting her commitment to social impact and sustainable development. 

Her interests lie in impactful writing, leadership, advocacy, and using storytelling as a tool for influence and change.
